disclaimer: Cross-lane protocol-neutrality matrix (P0.6C, model_identity closed P0.6D, litellm-sdk lane added P0.7A). Derived from offline-mock evidence and code review against installed SDK/framework shapes and current schema behavior. It is implementation-shape evidence only, NOT live provider semantic evidence, and NOT the ALMS runtime contract. No live provider request was made during P0.6C/P0.6D/P0.7A, and the LiteLLM Proxy Server was never started. The litellm-sdk lane audits the LiteLLM Python SDK (litellm.completion), NOT the LiteLLM Proxy Server; it was stress-tested against N-01..N-05 and does not reintroduce them.

openai-native.execution: offline_mock via real openai-native probe subprocess (CLI -> planner -> runner -> probe subprocess -> raw -> OpenAI normalizer -> results -> summary); zero provider calls / network / credential.

langchain.execution: offline_mock via real langchain probe subprocess; zero provider calls / network / credential.

anthropic-native.execution: offline_mock via real anthropic-native probe subprocess; zero provider calls / network / credential.

gemini-native.execution: offline_mock via real gemini-native probe subprocess; store=false on every request; zero provider calls / network / credential.

litellm-sdk.execution: offline_mock via real litellm-sdk probe subprocess using litellm's own mock_response seam (LiteLLM Python SDK, litellm.completion; NOT the Proxy Server); telemetry off, callbacks/cache empty, num_retries=0, no router/fallbacks, no base_url; zero provider calls / network / credential. The six fixtures do NOT all use an identical execution path (see execution_paths); TOOL-001 is a partial path (request transform + response-object injection), NOT the full completion(tools=...) path.
litellm-sdk.evidence: harness/tests/test_lane_dispatch.py::test_full_offline_litellm_simulation_all_six (+ prefix-strip / usage / framework-extension / execution-path stress); also test_compare.py::test_five_lane_diversity_comparison

TOOL-001.package_boundary_dependency: litellm.completion(tools=...) imports proxy MCP utilities requiring fastapi, absent by design in this SDK-only probe (finding L-01)

findings.summary: results._usage_block hardcoded provenance=reported for all present usage, so LangChain framework-normalized usage_metadata was indistinguishable from provider-reported usage.

results._usage_block read only OpenAI-nested cache/reasoning paths, so Anthropic cache_creation/cache_read and LangChain input_token_details tokens were dropped to null in the result summary; the result schema had no cache-creation/cache-read split.

Native provider/framework terminal states (requires_action, incomplete, budget_exceeded, refusal, stop_reason, finish_reason) were preserved only inside the transcript and collapsed to PASS/PASS_WITH_EXTENSION at the result level, with no queryable native-terminal field.
No centrally-owned provenance vocabulary existed; provider-vs-framework and reported-vs-estimated distinctions were expressed only by scattered signals.

probe-response.model holds the requested/configured model id; the provider-returned served model was preserved only in the raw response artifact, with no first-class returned-model field. Closed offline in P0.6D: result.observed_model_identity now carries requested_model / observed_returned_model / observed_returned_model_source / observed_returned_model_raw_ref / execution_mode / model_identity_match, derived per-lane from raw evidence with no fabrication and no canonicalization. Real returned-vs-requested provider routing/alias/snapshot behavior stays unverified_until_live.

LiteLLM SDK tool path couples to MCP/proxy-oriented dependencies. Invoking the selected completion surface with tool configuration (litellm.completion(tools=...)) in the proxy-free isolated environment imports LiteLLM utilities that require FastAPI (a proxy-server dependency). Impact: the SDK-only lane cannot exercise the complete TOOL-001 completion path without introducing server-layer dependencies; request transformation (get_optional_params) and response representation (litellm ModelResponse tool-call types) remain testable separately, and are what the lane exercises for TOOL-001. Contract impact: no shared ALMS evidence contract failure was observed (no false provenance, no false semantic equivalence, no contract loss). Live status: the complete completion(tools=...) path, provider adapter translation, provider request creation, network exception mapping, and provider-returned tool semantics remain unverified_until_live. Not F1: no reproducible shared-contract loss or false provenance was found.

dimensions.description: System instruction placement, message/input/step shape, model identity, output-token limit, timeout/retry ownership. Requested model kept separate from observed returned (see the model_identity dimension for the P0.6D closure of N-05).

openai-native.representation: Responses API input list + instructions; requested model on probe-response.model; served model on the raw response.
openai-native.notes: output-token limit + timeout/retry owned by probe controls (probe_derived).

langchain.representation: framework message objects -> provider request; requested model recorded exactly, never defaulted.
langchain.notes: framework mediates request shaping; retry ownership is framework-internal (retry_count_observed may be null).

anthropic-native.representation: Messages API top-level system + messages; requested model on probe-response.model.
anthropic-native.notes: system is a separate top-level field, not a message role.

gemini-native.representation: Interactions API top-level system_instruction + user_input step; store=false always; no previous_interaction_id.
gemini-native.notes: requested model on manifest; served model kept separately on the Interaction (see model_identity).

litellm-sdk.representation: litellm.completion(messages/tools/response_format); provider-qualified model string required (an unqualified model raises via get_llm_provider - no hidden default).
litellm-sdk.notes: SDK abstraction, not the Proxy Server; num_retries=0, no router/fallbacks, telemetry off, no base_url. Passing tools to completion routes through proxy MCP utilities (fastapi), so tool request translation is exercised via get_optional_params instead.

dimensions.description: Requested vs observed returned model, surfaced at the result level via observed_model_identity (P0.6D, N-05 resolved_offline). requested_model (request-side config) is never overwritten by, nor conflated with, observed_returned_model; a populated observed value carries an auditable raw_ref; source uses the central provenance vocabulary; exact strings are preserved (no canonicalization); a requested/observed mismatch is recorded, never auto-classified as an error. Offline observed values are fixture_expected; real returned-vs-requested routing/alias/snapshot behavior is unverified_until_live.

openai-native.representation: served model read from the native Responses object (response.model / stream response.completed); requested model on the manifest.
openai-native.notes: offline source=fixture_expected; live source=provider_native (unverified_until_live). Alias/snapshot never resolved.

langchain.representation: model id exposed only through framework response_metadata (model_name); requested model on the manifest.
langchain.notes: NEVER provider_native even when the string resembles an OpenAI id. Offline mock exposes model_name='offline-fake' != requested -> a recorded mismatch (model_identity_match=false), not an error.

anthropic-native.representation: served model read from the native Message resource (message.model / message_start); requested model on the manifest.
anthropic-native.notes: absent message model stays unavailable, never substituted from the requested model.

gemini-native.representation: served model read from the full Interaction resource (interaction.model), NOT the output_text convenience projection; requested model on the manifest.
gemini-native.notes: convenience projection never used as model authority; offline source=fixture_expected.

litellm-sdk.representation: served model read from litellm ModelResponse.model; LiteLLM STRIPS the provider prefix (openai/x -> x) while _hidden_params.litellm_model_name keeps the full requested string; requested model on the manifest.
litellm-sdk.notes: NEVER provider_native even though OpenAI-shaped. Offline source=fixture_expected; live source=framework_native (unverified_until_live). The prefix strip yields requested!=observed, recorded as model_identity_match=false (not corrected, not an error). Real alias/routing/snapshot behavior unverified_until_live.

dimensions.description: Authoritative raw container vs SDK convenience projection. Normalizers read authoritative structures (items/content-blocks/steps/messages), never convenience accessors.

openai-native.representation: response.output items (message/function_call); output_text is a convenience projection not relied upon.
openai-native.notes: output_text would be sdk_convenience; normalizer uses output items.

langchain.representation: AIMessage / AIMessageChunk; concrete framework types stay inside event data, never exposed as audit event types.

anthropic-native.notes: unknown block types preserved verbatim as provider_extension.

gemini-native.representation: Interaction resource + chronological steps; output_text convenience projection not relied upon.
gemini-native.notes: step-based container, not item-based; retained not reshaped to items.

litellm-sdk.representation: litellm ModelResponse (OpenAI ChatCompletion-shaped) choices/message; _hidden_params auxiliary metadata (api_base, litellm_model_name, response_cost, litellm_call_id) preserved distinctly.
litellm-sdk.notes: OpenAI-shaped but LiteLLM-owned; the container is framework output, not provider evidence. Convenience accessors not used as authority.

dimensions.description: Native JSON-schema vs framework-mediated strategy vs tool extraction. schema-valid text alone is NOT native-structured proof.

openai-native.notes: parsed value + validation outcome kept distinct from raw text.

litellm-sdk.representation: response_format json_schema translated by LiteLLM via get_optional_params (framework-mediated); local JSON parse + local schema-presence check kept distinct from raw text.
litellm-sdk.notes: classified framework_response_format, NOT native_json_schema; NO silent tool fallback; valid JSON alone is not native-structured proof; provider validation unverified_until_live.

dimensions.description: Function calls / tool-use blocks / function-call steps. Distinct provider call IDs kept distinct; parallel execution never inferred; raw arguments preserved.

langchain.representation: message.tool_calls with framework-generated ids; args preserved raw.
langchain.notes: framework ids marked distinct from provider call ids in data.

anthropic-native.notes: multiple tool_use blocks -> multiple distinct tool_call_completed, not merged.

gemini-native.representation: function_call step id/name/arguments; requires_action when a call awaits result.
gemini-native.notes: requires_action is a native non-terminal state, kept as provider_extension.

litellm-sdk.representation: TOOL-001 partial path (see finding L-01 + fixture_coverage.execution_paths): tool request translation exercised via litellm.utils.get_optional_params (tools -> provider params); tool-call RESPONSE injected via litellm ModelResponse types; id/name/raw-argument-string/order preserved. This is NOT the full litellm.completion(tools=...) path.
litellm-sdk.notes: L-01: passing tools to litellm.completion routes through proxy MCP utilities importing fastapi (a proxy-server dependency), absent by design in this SDK-only lane; so the full completion(tools=...) path is NOT exercised. Verified offline: model routing inspection, tool request schema transformation, LiteLLM tool-call response representation (id/name/raw args/order), normalization + result construction, no tool execution, no parallel-execution inference. Unverified offline (unverified_until_live): the complete completion(tools=...) path, provider adapter translation, provider request creation, network exception mapping, provider-returned tool semantics. Framework tool-call ids are not assumed provider ids.

dimensions.description: Provider event types / item / content-block / Interaction-step lifecycles / framework chunks. Unknown events preserved; ordering kept; live event delivery unverified offline.

openai-native.representation: response.* item stream events; unknown -> provider_extension.
openai-native.notes: offline mock lifecycle preserved; real event stream unverified_until_live.

langchain.representation: AIMessageChunk stream; synthesized terminal chunk -> framework_extension.
langchain.notes: framework chunks never labelled provider events.

anthropic-native.representation: message/content_block lifecycle (start/delta/stop) + ping; block lifecycle -> provider_extension.

gemini-native.notes: Interaction step lifecycle retained; thought_signature_delta structural-only.

litellm-sdk.representation: CustomStreamWrapper -> ModelResponseStream chunks (OpenAI chat.completion.chunk-shaped); delta content; stream_options include_usage terminal usage chunk; aggregate via stream_chunk_builder.
litellm-sdk.notes: chunks are LiteLLM-normalized, NEVER labelled provider events; order preserved; live event delivery unverified_until_live.

dimensions.description: Input/output/cached/cache-creation/cache-read/reasoning-thought/total tokens; provider-reported vs framework-normalized; missing usage stays null. Hardened by N-01/N-02.

openai-native.representation: provider usage block; cache_read from input_tokens_details, reasoning from output_tokens_details.
openai-native.notes: source=provider_native; no cache-creation split reported (stays null).

langchain.notes: source=framework_native (N-01 fix): no longer indistinguishable from provider-reported.

anthropic-native.representation: provider usage with cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens split.
anthropic-native.notes: both cache halves now survive into the result summary (N-02 fix); no total reported (null).

gemini-native.representation: Interaction usage totals incl total_cached_tokens + total_thought_tokens.
gemini-native.notes: thought->reasoning_tokens documented mapping; cache read preserved.

litellm-sdk.representation: litellm ModelResponse.usage (OpenAI-shaped: prompt/completion/total + prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens + completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens); offline synthesized by token_counter.
litellm-sdk.notes: source=framework_native (N-01 stress: OpenAI-shaped usage from a framework is NOT provider-reported); cache_read + reasoning survive; missing stays null (never 0); offline usage is synthesized, real provider usage unverified_until_live.

dimensions.description: Reported vs locally estimated cost, kept distinct.

openai-native.representation: no provider dollar cost; cost_estimated from pricing snapshot when priced.

langchain.representation: same local estimate path; token base is framework-normalized.
langchain.notes: estimate provenance separate from usage source.

anthropic-native.representation: no provider dollar cost; cost_estimated when priced.

gemini-native.representation: no provider dollar cost; cost_estimated when priced.

litellm-sdk.representation: litellm _hidden_params.response_cost (null offline / unpriced synthetic model); harness cost_estimated from pricing snapshot when priced.
litellm-sdk.notes: response_cost is a LiteLLM ESTIMATE, never labelled billed cost; cost_reported null.

dimensions.description: Provider/framework terminal signal made queryable at result level via observed_terminal_state (N-03). Different axis from the audit status verdict.

gemini-native.notes: unknown native status kept verbatim, category unknown; no data loss.

litellm-sdk.notes: source=framework_native: finish_reason is LiteLLM-normalized, not provider-native (N-03 stress: terminal signal stays observable, framework-owned).

dimensions.description: Provider-native vs framework extension handling. Native-but-unmapped semantics become provider_extension; framework transformations become framework_extension; the two are never conflated (results._derive_status; DevSpec Sections 31, 43, 48).

openai-native.representation: unknown native item/stream events -> provider_extension; refusal -> provider_extension; no framework_extension.
openai-native.notes: framework_extension count is 0 for a native lane.

langchain.representation: synthesized stream chunks + framework message metadata (additional_kwargs/invalid_tool_calls) -> framework_extension; never provider_extension.
langchain.notes: a framework transformation is never labelled provider-native.

anthropic-native.representation: content-block lifecycle (start/stop), ping, refusal, unknown blocks -> provider_extension; no framework_extension.

gemini-native.representation: Interaction step lifecycle, thought step/signature, requires_action, unknown native events -> provider_extension; no framework_extension.
gemini-native.notes: google-genai is the provider SDK, so its unknowns are provider_extension, not framework_extension.

litellm-sdk.representation: _hidden_params, routing, tool_request_translation, and unknown fields -> framework_extension; NEVER provider_extension.
litellm-sdk.notes: LiteLLM is a framework abstraction, so a litellm lane never emits a provider_extension event even though its output is OpenAI-shaped.

dimensions.description: Server-side storage, state identifiers, thought signatures, credential presence. Booleans-only credential presence; opaque signatures never expanded to text.

openai-native.representation: stateless request; response id in raw; no store reuse.
openai-native.notes: run manifest records credential presence booleans only.

langchain.representation: stateless framework call; provider request id preserved in raw/error.

anthropic-native.representation: stateless Messages request; request_id in raw.

gemini-native.representation: store=false on every request; no previous_interaction_id; thought_signature kept as presence bool only.
gemini-native.notes: storage policy explicit; thought signature opaque, never reasoning text.

litellm-sdk.representation: stateless litellm.completion; litellm_call_id in _hidden_params; run manifest records credential presence booleans only.
litellm-sdk.notes: SDK boundary only - no Proxy Server, virtual keys, gateway auth, proxy DB, spend tracking, or multi-tenant state; no server-state reuse.

dimensions.description: Provider vs framework vs runtime error; timeout/cancellation is client-side action, not proof provider stopped.

langchain.notes: framework exception type distinguished from provider cause.

anthropic-native.notes: native cause preserved before generic categorization.

gemini-native.notes: errorevent stream events preserved; timeout/cancel recorded as client-side action only.

litellm-sdk.representation: LiteLLM exception taxonomy (its OWN OpenAI-shaped classes: InternalServerError/BadRequestError/RateLimitError/...) with llm_provider/status_code/model + underlying cause chain.
litellm-sdk.notes: the LiteLLM exception class is distinguished from the provider cause and is NEVER labelled provider-native; offline exception exercised via litellm's mock exception seam; real network-mapped provider exceptions unverified_until_live (no live error fixture authorized).
